Issue: Login Failure
Description: Users are unable to log in due to credential verification errors.
Severity: High
Frequency: Often

Symptoms:
- Error message: 'Invalid credentials'
- Timeout on the login screen

Causes:
- Server authentication error
- Network connectivity issues

Solutions:
- Restart the authentication server and verify network connectivity. (Est. time: 15 minutes)
  Steps:
  1. Restart the authentication server.
  2. Check the network connection and verify stability.

Diagnostic Tests:
- Server Connectivity Test: Checks if the server is reachable.
  Procedure: Ping the server and verify response time.

Log Entries:
- [2023-10-07T15:30:00Z] ERROR: Authentication server did not respond in time.

Frequently Asked Questions:
- Q: What can cause login failures?
  A: Login failures may be due to server issues or network problems. Please check connectivity.

User Feedback:
- Rating: 3/5, Date: 2023-10-07
  Comment: The solution worked, but it took too long.

Issue: Crash on Startup
Description: The application crashes immediately after launch.
Severity: Critical
Frequency: Intermittent

Symptoms:
- Application closes unexpectedly without error message.

Causes:
- Corrupted installation or missing dependencies

Solutions:
- Reinstall the application to restore missing or corrupted files. (Est. time: 30 minutes)
  Steps:
  1. Uninstall the current version of the application.
  2. Download the latest installer from the official website.
  3. Install the application and restart your computer.

Diagnostic Tests:
- Installation Integrity Test: Verifies the integrity of installed files.
  Procedure: Run the built-in installer repair tool.

Log Entries:
- [2023-10-08T09:15:00Z] ERROR: Unexpected termination detected during startup.

Frequently Asked Questions:
- Q: What should I do if the app crashes on startup?
  A: Try reinstalling the application to ensure all files are intact.

User Feedback:
- Rating: 2/5, Date: 2023-10-08
  Comment: Frequent crashes make the app unusable until reinstalled.

Issue: Slow Performance
Description: The application responds slowly and exhibits lag during usage.
Severity: Medium
Frequency: Common

Symptoms:
- Delayed response to user inputs.
- Laggy animations or transitions.

Causes:
- High CPU usage due to memory leaks.

Solutions:
- Restart the application and clear cache to resolve performance issues. (Est. time: 10 minutes)
  Steps:
  1. Close the application and reopen it.
  2. Clear the application cache from Settings.

Diagnostic Tests:
- Performance Benchmark Test: Measures CPU and memory usage during application runtime.
  Procedure: Use the built-in performance monitor for 5 minutes.

Log Entries:
- [2023-10-09T12:00:00Z] WARNING: High memory usage detected.

Frequently Asked Questions:
- Q: Why is the app running slowly?
  A: High resource usage and memory leaks can cause performance degradation. Try clearing the cache or restarting.

User Feedback:
- Rating: 3/5, Date: 2023-10-09
  Comment: The app lags when multiple features are in use.

Issue: Data Sync Error
Description: Data synchronization between the device and the cloud fails intermittently.
Severity: High
Frequency: Often

Symptoms:
- Sync failure notifications appear.
- Data remains outdated on the device.

Causes:
- Expired authentication token or connectivity issues.

Solutions:
- Reauthenticate and check internet connection to restore data synchronization. (Est. time: 20 minutes)
  Steps:
  1. Log out and log back in to refresh authentication.
  2. Verify internet connectivity and trigger a manual sync.

Diagnostic Tests:
- Network Connectivity Test: Ensures stable network connection for data sync.
  Procedure: Run a ping test to the server.

Log Entries:
- [2023-10-10T14:45:00Z] ERROR: Data synchronization failed due to token expiry.

Frequently Asked Questions:
- Q: How do I fix data sync errors?
  A: Ensure your internet connection is stable and reauthenticate your account.

User Feedback:
- Rating: 4/5, Date: 2023-10-10
  Comment: Sync issues are annoying but resolved after re-login.

Issue: Unexpected Shutdown
Description: The application shuts down unexpectedly during operation without any warning.
Severity: High
Frequency: Occasional

Symptoms:
- The application closes suddenly and restarts.

Causes:
- Hardware overheating or critical software bug.

Solutions:
- Monitor hardware temperature and update the application to the latest version. (Est. time: 25 minutes)
  Steps:
  1. Check your device's temperature using a monitoring tool.
  2. Install any available updates for the application.

Diagnostic Tests:
- Temperature Diagnostic Test: Measures the hardware temperature during usage.
  Procedure: Use a temperature monitoring utility for a 10-minute test.

Log Entries:
- [2023-10-11T08:20:00Z] WARNING: Unexpected shutdown detected during heavy load.

Frequently Asked Questions:
- Q: What should I do if the app shuts down unexpectedly?
  A: Monitor your device temperature and ensure you are using the latest software version.

User Feedback:
- Rating: 2/5, Date: 2023-10-11
  Comment: The unexpected shutdowns are very disruptive.
